question: What is the annual retention rate of legislators who began their first term between January 1, 1917 and December 31, 1999, measured as the proportion of this cohort still in office on December 31st for each of the first 20 years following their initial term start? The results should show all 20 periods in sequence regardless of whether any legislators were retained in a particular year.

WITH cohort AS (
    SELECT 
        lt.id_bioguide,
        lt.term_start,
        CAST(substr(lt.term_start, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) as start_year
    FROM legislators_terms lt
    WHERE lt.term_number = 0
      AND lt.term_start >= '1917-01-01'
      AND lt.term_start <= '1999-12-31'
),
year_offsets AS (
    SELECT 1 as year_offset UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
    UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10
    UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15
    UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19 UNION ALL SELECT 20
),
checks AS (
    SELECT 
        c.id_bioguide,
        c.start_year,
        c.start_year + yo.year_offset as check_year,
        yo.year_offset as year_after_start
    FROM cohort c
    CROSS JOIN year_offsets yo
),
retention AS (
    SELECT 
        c.year_after_start,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.id_bioguide) as total_in_cohort,
        COUNT(DISTINCT lt2.id_bioguide) as still_in_office
    FROM checks c
    LEFT JOIN legislators_terms lt2 
        ON c.id_bioguide = lt2.id_bioguide
        AND lt2.term_start <= CAST(c.check_year AS VARCHAR) || '-12-31'
        AND lt2.term_end >= CAST(c.check_year AS VARCHAR) || '-12-31'
    GROUP BY c.year_after_start
)
SELECT 
    year_after_start,
    ROUND(1.0 * still_in_office / total_in_cohort, 4) as retention_rate
FROM retention 
ORDER BY year_after_start
